correctness.independent_verification: Independently enumerated all 2^16 defect masks at L=4 under the triangular independent-set condition, recovering exact polynomial 1+16z+72z²+96z³+16z⁴ and count 201. Verified all one-/two-spin stability conditions via physical flip supports on those stable masks and explicit 8×8 three-flip defect support {(1,2),(3,2),(1,4)}. L=4 is supplementary boundary outside theorem; all L>=8 and exponential bound rest on conditional block argument. Package verify.py inspected and not taken as proof.
correctness.rationale: For dyadic torus L=2^k>=8, in characteristic two the spin-defect linear operator I+X+Y satisfies (I+X+Y)^L=I, so the correspondence is bijective. One-spin non-lowering condition is at most one defect in each triangular three-plaquette flip support, equivalent to independence in the six-neighbor triangular graph. For two distinct spin flips supports have either 0 or 1 shared plaquette; the toggled symmetric difference contains at most two defects, so no two-spin move lowers energy. For the three flips (1,2),(2,2),(1,3), the symmetric difference is the three defects at (1,2),(3,2),(1,4). Setting the first two defects and forbidding other defects in a 5×5 block is compatible with ANY independent exterior, and lowers energy by J. Conditional uniform independent-set probability of the exact witness is at least 2^-25 per one of floor(L/5)^2 disjoint blocks; iteration bounds A3/A1 <= exp(−L²/(100*2^25)). Hard-hexagon pressure converts this into the stated limsup entropy gap; no sharp 3-spin pressure or quench rate is asserted.
